body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> LG Electronics(www.lge.co.kr) displayed its 120-inch multi vision PDP during KES 2009, which consists of four 60-inch PDP TVs. With the slim outline of 2mm thickness, this high-resolution multi vision PDP features 1,000,000:1 mega contrast ratio, 0.001ms response speed, 600Hz motion technology and more. According to the company, it will be launched in Korea and China markets in 2010.
